GRADE 5 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 48 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. This mock paper follows CBC assessment style.
2. Answer all questions.
3. Manage your time carefully.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Medicinal Trees at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. list the most common medicinal plants for familiarisation,
   B. Learners should ignore Medicinal Trees completely.
   C. Medicinal Trees is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Medicinal Trees.

2. About Medicinal Trees at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the right use of medicinal plants for safe use,
   B. Learners should ignore Medicinal Trees completely.
   C. Medicinal Trees is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Medicinal Trees.

3. About Medicinal Trees when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Nurture the medicinal plants for preservation of environment,
   B. Learners should ignore Medicinal Trees completely.
   C. Medicinal Trees is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Medicinal Trees.

5. About Scriptural Stories and Family Values at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the teachings of Scriptures at family level for development of moral values,
   B. Learners should ignore Scriptural Stories and Family Values completely.
   C. Scriptural Stories and Family Values is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Scriptural Stories and Family Values.

6. About Scriptural Stories and Family Values at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate the teachings that promote moral values in families as per selected Scriptures from the four faiths,
   B. Learners should ignore Scriptural Stories and Family Values completely.
   C. Scriptural Stories and Family Values is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Scriptural Stories and Family Values.

7. About Scriptural Stories and Family Values when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the teachings of Scriptures at family level for development of moral values,
   B. Learners should ignore Scriptural Stories and Family Values completely.
   C. Scriptural Stories and Family Values is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Scriptural Stories and Family Values.

9. About Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe features of places in worship for familiarisation,
   B. Learners should ignore Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara completely.
   C. Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara.

10. About Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. analyse the features at the places of worship in Jains and Sikhs for understanding,
   B. Learners should ignore Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara completely.
   C. Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara.

11. About Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. describe features of places in worship for familiarisation,
   B. Learners should ignore Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara completely.
   C. Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Importance Of Features In Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara.

13. About Places of Worship at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the locations of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara (temples) in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Places of Worship completely.
   C. Places of Worship is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Places of Worship.

14. About Places of Worship at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. classify the practices and ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara,
   B. Learners should ignore Places of Worship completely.
   C. Places of Worship is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Places of Worship.

15. About Places of Worship when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the locations of Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara (temples) in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Places of Worship completely.
   C. Places of Worship is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Places of Worship.

17. About Friendship and Keeping Promises at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the qualities of a good friendship for a healthy social relationship,
   B. Learners should ignore Friendship and Keeping Promises completely.
   C. Friendship and Keeping Promises is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Friendship and Keeping Promises.

18. About Friendship and Keeping Promises at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. distinguish t between good and bad friendship,
   B. Learners should ignore Friendship and Keeping Promises completely.
   C. Friendship and Keeping Promises is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Friendship and Keeping Promises.

19. About Friendship and Keeping Promises when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the qualities of a good friendship for a healthy social relationship,
   B. Learners should ignore Friendship and Keeping Promises completely.
   C. Friendship and Keeping Promises is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Friendship and Keeping Promises.

21. About Physical Aspect of Yoga at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify Pranayam and Asanas for physical well- being,
   B. Learners should ignore Physical Aspect of Yoga completely.
   C. Physical Aspect of Yoga is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Physical Aspect of Yoga.

22. About Physical Aspect of Yoga at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the types of Pranayam and Asanas for familiarisation,
   B. Learners should ignore Physical Aspect of Yoga completely.
   C. Physical Aspect of Yoga is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Physical Aspect of Yoga.

23. About Physical Aspect of Yoga when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. outline benefits of environmental protection for communal wellness,
   B. Learners should ignore Physical Aspect of Yoga completely.
   C. Physical Aspect of Yoga is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Physical Aspect of Yoga.
